races.paceDynamic: Run For Mahler will lead from the start with no obvious pace pressure in this small field, allowing her to dictate terms at a sustainable gallop. Murcia and Chosen Comrade may track in behind but neither is keen enough to challenge early. The lack of pace pressure means the race will likely develop into a sprint from 2f out when the hold-up horses like Grainne A Chroi and Royal Hollow try to make their moves. This steady pace followed by a sharp acceleration strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can close quickly rather than those needing a truly run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Run For Mahler gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows her to conserve energy and find extra when challenged. Her proven course form and 218-day break could have her primed for a big effort.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian and one of the hold-up horses has superior finishing speed
scenarios.body: Grainne A Chroi or Royal Hollow benefit from the slow pace to unleash a devastating late kick. Their class tells in a sprint finish from the back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Murcia or Chosen Comrade improve their position turning for home
scenarios.body: The Mullins mare uses her class advantage to gradually wear down Run For Mahler in the final furlong. Her Grade 1 winning form gives her the edge in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and favours an unconsidered runner
scenarios.body: Royal Hollow's recent chase win could have brought improvement that isn't reflected in her hurdle rating. Her versatility between codes might be the key factor.

watchPoints.text: Run For Mahler needs to be monitored for over-racing early given her front-running style and long absence
Grainne A Chroi showed pulling up tendencies last time which could recur if not travelling well
Murcia's market move will be crucial given her inconsistent recent form despite highest rating
Royal Hollow's jumping between hurdles and chases could indicate which discipline suits better
Swing Davis requires strong market support given Elliott's record with point-to-point graduates returning from breaks

races.paceDynamic: Gomez Addams, Phoenix Arizona, and Approval will force a strong gallop from the outset in this competitive 17-runner maiden hurdle. With three confirmed front-runners and several prominent racers like Penny Express, Bells Grove, and Touch The Moon likely to track close, the early pace will be relentless over the extended 2m4f trip. The stamina-sapping tempo will expose the weaker stayers and set up a tactical finish where positioning becomes crucial. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can conserve energy early and produce a sustained finish when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast and fade from 2f out
scenarios.body: The relentless early pace takes its toll as Gomez Addams, Phoenix Arizona and Approval weaken, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past. Small Fry and Touch The Moon benefit most from their energy-conserving tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Penny Express or Touch The Moon track the pace perfectly and kick clear
scenarios.body: The experienced maiden hurdle performers use their course knowledge and tactical speed to position ideally behind the leaders before striking. Their stamina proves superior to the hold-up horses who get too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Gomez Addams shows his bumper class and stays strongly
scenarios.body: The Henry De Bromhead-trained gelding proves his Galway festival bumper win was no fluke by dominating from the front. His superior class allows him to dictate throughout and resist all challengers in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and a big-priced hold-up horse strikes late
scenarios.body: The combination of strong early pace and large field creates chaos, allowing a patient outsider to weave through and capitalise. Forlio or Dar Toungi emerge from the pack to claim surprise victory.

watchPoints.text: Gomez Addams must prove his Galway bumper win wasn't a one-off after disappointing subsequent runs
Phoenix Arizona and Approval could set unsustainable fractions if they engage in an early duel
Touch The Moon's proven stamina on good going makes him dangerous if tracking the pace perfectly
Small Fry needs to overcome modest previous hurdle form despite his Flat credentials
Penny Express jumping left throughout when pulled up at Clonmel suggests technique concerns remain

races.paceDynamic: Burning Ability will lead from the start with his confirmed front-running style, setting an honest but manageable gallop over this extended trip. Jack Owen Jack and Withabitofluk should track prominently behind the leader, while the hold-up horses Royal Approval, Speed For Fun, and Black Dakota will be positioned towards the rear. With only one confirmed pace-setter and no obvious pressure from prominent racers, this will develop into a test of stamina in the final half-mile. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours horses with finishing kicks who can position handily and have the class to quicken when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Burning Ability sets an honest but uncontested lead through the early stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a staying test from the final hurdle with plenty left in the tank for the finish. Horses with class and a turn of foot from prominent positions will have every chance to show their quality.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Burning Ability's fitness edge and front-running tactics prove too much for this maiden field
scenarios.body: His December hurdle form looks solid for this grade and he can utilize his 109-day break to maximum effect. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to dictate terms and kick clear approaching the last.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses can overcome their tactical disadvantage through superior class
scenarios.body: Royal Approval's Flat background provides stamina reserves while Speed For Fun brings Mullins' French import credentials. Their ability to finish strongly becomes decisive despite giving the leaders a significant start.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Burning Ability fails to maintain his gallop and the race becomes a crawl
scenarios.body: The lack of alternative pace-setters creates a muddling affair where any horse can win from anywhere. Form lines become unreliable and the most battle-hardened performer can capitalize on the tactical confusion.

watchPoints.text: Burning Ability must prove his fitness after 109 days off and avoid the tailed-off effort he produced in February
Speed For Fun's running style remains unclear from French Flat form but Mullins rarely runs no-hopers in these contests
Jack Owen Jack showed improvement at Kilbeggan and could benefit from the step up in trip if building on that effort
Withabitofluk has been bitterly disappointing over hurdles despite showing ability in bumpers for De Bromhead
Royal Approval needs to overcome a 224-day layoff but his Flat stamina could prove decisive if fit enough

runners_data.name: Mr Eastwood

runners_data.spotlight: Has shown some ability in maiden hurdles but poor efforts in two chases and on handicap hurdle debut at Limerick (2m5f, heavy); cheekpieces go on but others more likely.

runners_data.name: Strand Street Lass
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with terrible record, new blinkers and tongue tie suggest desperation
runners_data.comment: Handicap debutante, shown nothing in maidens, blinkers on, hard to fancy; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to complete either point-to-point and tailed off in completed runs under rules; impossible to fancy; blinkers added to tongue tie now; declared for 7.00 at Tramore on Friday.

races.paceDynamic: Sean Mc is the only confirmed front runner in this 21-runner field and should get an uncontested lead from the start, with prominent runners like Jay Pee, King Ferdinand, and Mollys Dolly settling behind rather than pressuring. The lack of pace pressure means Sean Mc can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages before the large field of hold-up horses try to mount challenges from the back. With 15+ runners adopting hold-up tactics including Jaadil, Poppycon, and Where Are You Now, traffic problems are inevitable in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can avoid the scramble behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Sean Mc gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows Sean Mc to save energy and pull clear when the field gets in each other's way. His stamina edge over 2m4½f proves decisive as hold-up horses struggle for racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Jay Pee or Mollys Dolly can track Sean Mc without traffic issues
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get first run on the leader while the hold-up brigade still face congestion problems. Superior class tells in the final furlong with clear racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Gets Lucky
scenarios.trigger: If Jaadil or Poppycon finds a clear passage through the field
scenarios.body: One of the classier hold-up horses manages to weave through without checking and arrives with a strong late run. Their superior ability overcomes the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Sean Mc stops suddenly and creates a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader hits the wall dramatically, leaving a bunched field to fight it out. Chaos ensues with multiple hard-luck stories and an unconsidered runner benefits from the scrimmaging.

watchPoints.text: Sean Mc getting away with soft fractions early - if unchallenged he could prove very hard to peg back
Traffic chaos in the straight with 15+ hold-up horses converging simultaneously from the rear
Jay Pee and Mollys Dolly getting prominent positions early to avoid the inevitable scrambling behind
King Ferdinand's market move after 519 days off would be significant given his ability when fresh
Where Are You Now and Johnny M as reserves - if either gets in they bring different tactical dimensions

races.name: Insurance Wise Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Elusive Ogie

runners_data.name: Garnacho

runners_data.spotlight: Justified strong market support when scoring by 12l on debut for this yard at Bellewstown (2m5f, good) in July; has struggled off 16lb higher mark in three runs since; may need some help from the handicapper.

runners_data.name: Falco Blitz

runners_data.name: Hamsiyann

runners_data.name: Earl Neigh

runners_data.name: Big Dispute

runners_data.name: One And Only

runners_data.name: Chanceawetmorning

runners_data.spotlight: Unbeaten from two starts since joining this yard; well-backed to win a Kilbeggan handicap in April (2m1f, good to yielding) and followed up with today's rider aboard at Clonmel next time; made to work harder to win last time and is up another 7lb, but this step up in trip could unlock a bit more.

races.paceDynamic: Earl Neigh and Big Dispute will dictate from the front, with Earl Neigh the more natural leader but Big Dispute equally capable of forcing the issue. With multiple prominent runners like Rockonliam, Garnacho, and Chanceawetmorning sitting just behind, this creates a strong gallop throughout the 2m4½f trip. The pace will be honest but not suicidal, allowing the race to develop into a proper staying test from the second-last hurdle. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those who can produce a sustained finish, as the early pace will set up perfectly for closers to sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Sweep Past
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest and the leaders tire from two out
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will find out Earl Neigh and Big Dispute, while High Court Cave and Hamsiyann can use their hold-up style to devastating effect. One And Only could also benefit despite his poor recent form if the race falls apart late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate and allows tactical horses to strike
scenarios.body: Chanceawetmorning and Rockonliam can position perfectly behind the leaders and have enough pace to quicken when it matters. Their class and tactical speed will prove decisive in a finish where the leaders don't completely collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Earl Neigh or Big Dispute can dictate at a steady tempo
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and has enough left to resist late challengers on this stiff track. Big Dispute's recent form revival makes him the more likely beneficiary if the pace scenario develops favorably.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes unsustainably fast between the leaders
scenarios.body: The entire field comes back to the closers in dramatic fashion, allowing even unfancied hold-up horses to get competitive. This would suit any horse with a devastating turn of foot who has been held up out the back.

watchPoints.text: Earl Neigh and Big Dispute could set suicidal fractions if they engage in early battle, playing into closers' hands
High Court Cave has ideal hold-up style for this pace but amateur rider Mr O McGill may not get ideal position
Chanceawetmorning's unbeaten record for Elliott makes him dangerous if positioned behind the early pace
Hamsiyann's tendency to fade suggests stamina doubts despite hold-up style suiting race shape
Rockonliam's 153-day absence could prove beneficial if this develops into genuine staying test

runners_data.name: Embrace The Day

races.paceDynamic: Whatsavailable will take the field along as the only confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable gallop that shouldn't be overly demanding early in this handicap. The prominent runners Ceroc, Brideswell Lad, Somersby Roost, Way Down South, Shesakindofmagic, and Silent Guardian will track closely behind, while the hold-up horses Only For Our Man, Its Not Over Yet, Rhythmic Tune, and Embrace The Day will settle further back. With Whatsavailable prone to fading in the finish and no real pace pressure, this sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses who can capitalize on a strong gallop and finish powerfully. The tactical verdict clearly favors the hold-up profile who can exploit the honest pace and Whatsavailable's finishing limitations.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Whatsavailable sets honest pace but fades as expected in final furlong
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will perfectly suit the patient tactics of the hold-up brigade who can unleash late runs. Only For Our Man and Rhythmic Tune are best positioned to exploit this scenario with their strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can stay close enough to Whatsavailable without overexerting
scenarios.body: Somersby Roost or Way Down South could strike if they travel well in behind the leader and have enough left to capitalize when Whatsavailable weakens. Their forward positions give them first strike capability before the hold-up horses arrive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Whatsavailable holds on
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes moderate and Whatsavailable conserves energy for a sustained finish
scenarios.body: Despite his fading tendency, a tactical ride could see him maintain just enough of his early advantage. The longer trip may actually help him sustain his effort better than over shorter distances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Whatsavailable goes too slow early and prominent runners get restless
scenarios.body: A messy tactical affair could develop with multiple horses trying to improve position simultaneously. This chaos would likely favor the most experienced campaigners who can navigate the traffic.

watchPoints.text: Whatsavailable could surprise if he settles better than usual and conserves energy for sustained finish
Only For Our Man's 7lb penalty may prove insufficient to stop him if the pace sets up perfectly
Somersby Roost faces significant 10lb rise but her easy Cork win suggests she may handle the hike
The prominent runners could get drawn into a mid-race battle if Whatsavailable goes too steadily
Several 5lb and 7lb claiming jockeys add pressure in tight handicap where every pound counts
